title: install-python.ps1 flattens the user PATH and skips it when uv is already installed
goal: install-python.ps1 adds %USERPROFILE%\.local\bin to the user PATH by reading and writing HKCU\Environment Path raw (DoNotExpandEnvironmentNames, written back as ExpandString), so %VAR% entries stay as they were, and it runs that step whenever uv is installed or already installed, so the pinned uv is always on the user PATH afterwards.
notes: Found by the fresh-context review of SP-fep4fpsx “Windows ready” (ST-xqx3ffyu).
